description: Behavioral evals for the wiki-search skill, run by seeding a vault per `setup`, issuing `prompt` to an agent that has loaded this skill, and grading the agent's actions/answer against `expected_behavior` (must hold) and `must_not` (must be absent). Since TASK 028 the ENGINE auto-broadens: bare query terms are stemmed + prefixed (per-term by script: Cyrillic→russian, Latin→english) and ё/е-folded on both the query and the body corpus, with `--exact`/`--no-stem` as the literal opt-out. So the suite now pins BOTH (a) the agent correctly RELYING on default stemming (cases 4-6, 8) rather than hand-crafting prefixes, AND (b) the residual duties stemming does NOT cover — manual broadening for non-morphological misses like acronym letter-transposition (case 2), `--exact` for precision (case 7), and the anti-hallucination GROUNDING rule (cases 1-3). These are behavioural evals (subagent-graded), not the scored 4-critic harness used by wiki-verify.

evals.name: normal-hit-grounded
evals.setup: Vault `personal` is registered + indexed and contains a page 'Сценарии продаж П-К-Ч' whose body uses the token 'ПКЧ' many times.
evals.expected_behavior: Invokes `wiki-search "пкч" --vaults personal` (the on-PATH wrapper, not `python -m scripts...`); returns the П-К-Ч page among the hits; any answer is grounded in it and cites the slug.
must_not: fabricate a definition
claim the term is absent from the wiki

evals.name: zero-hit-must-broaden-non-morphological
evals.setup: Same vault. The term is indexed as 'ПКЧ' / 'П-К-Ч' only — the string 'КПЧ' (К↔П transposed) appears nowhere. NB: engine stemming does NOT fix this — a letter transposition is not a morphological inflection, and ALL-CAPS acronyms are not stemmed.
evals.expected_behavior: The first query (`кпч` / `кпч сценарий`) still returns count 0 (stemming can't repair the transposition); the agent does NOT stop there — it BROADENS per the skill: searches the distinctive content words (e.g. `сценарии продаж` — now auto-stemmed), and/or tries the transposed/hyphenated acronym (`ПКЧ`/`П-К-Ч`), finds 'Сценарии продаж П-К-Ч', and answers grounded in that page (may note the term is likely spelled ПКЧ).
must_not: conclude 'not in the wiki' after only the literal КПЧ query
invent an expansion of КПЧ (e.g. 'Кризис → Падение → Частичное восстановление')
answer from general knowledge presented as the vault's content

evals.name: genuinely-absent-no-hallucination
evals.setup: Same vault. No page mentions 'квантовая криптография' in any spelling/inflection — so even the default stemmed+folded query returns nothing.
evals.prompt: what does my wiki say about квантовой криптографии?
evals.expected_behavior: The default (stemmed `квантов*`/`криптограф*`) search is already broad and still returns empty; the agent states plainly that no page in the wiki matches the term and offers `/wiki-enrich` to add a source.
must_not: fabricate a definition or any domain fact about the term
present an ungrounded answer as if it came from the vault

evals.name: inflection-default-stemming-finds-it
evals.setup: Vault `personal`. A QED course page '03 - Первое касание' is ABOUT 'продуктовое осведомление' (body uses 'осведомление'/'осведомленность' and 'продуктовая', NOT the exact pair 'продуктовое осведомление'). A separate AI-panel page mentions 'продуктовое мышление' once.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the DEFAULT search `wiki-search "продуктовое осведомление" --vaults personal` (no manual `*`); engine stemming (`продуктов*` AND `осведомлен*`) ranks the on-topic '03 - Первое касание' near the top and AND-excludes the tangential 'продуктовое мышление' page; the agent answers grounded in '03 - Первое касание', citing its slug.
must_not: answer from the tangential AI-panel 'продуктовое мышление' page
hand-craft a manual prefix query as the FIRST attempt (the engine already stems)
claim FTS has no stemming

evals.name: stemming-recall-default
evals.setup: Vault `personal`. A page's body uses 'сценарий'/'продажи' (inflected) and its title is 'Сценарии продаж П-К-Ч'.
evals.prompt: search the wiki for сценарии продаж
evals.expected_behavior: The DEFAULT search finds the page even though the body uses different inflections — the agent does NOT need to add `*` or re-try; one bare query suffices because terms are stemmed (`сценар*`/`продаж*`).
must_not: assert the page is missing because the body uses a different inflection
manually craft `сценари*` before trying the bare query

evals.name: yo-e-fold-parity
evals.setup: Vault `personal`, reindexed with `wiki-reindex --full`. A page body contains 'объём' (with ё).
evals.expected_behavior: The default `wiki-search "объем"` finds the 'объём' page (ё/е folded on both sides); the agent does NOT need to try the ё spelling separately.
must_not: report 0 hits and conclude the term is absent
instruct the user to retry with the ё spelling

evals.name: exact-precision-opt-out
evals.setup: Vault `personal`. The operator wants a precise literal match for a specific term and is getting too many inflected hits by default.
evals.prompt: find pages that mention exactly the word агент (not агенты, агентство, агентурный)
evals.expected_behavior: Recognises that default stemming broadens (`агент*` matches агенты/агентство); uses `wiki-search "агент" --exact --vaults personal` to disable stemming for a precise literal search; explains that `--exact` keeps the ё/е fold but turns off inflection broadening.
must_not: claim there is no way to do a precise/literal search
use `--exact` for an ordinary recall query where broadening is wanted

evals.name: mixed-ru-en-stemming
evals.setup: Vault `personal`. A page body discusses 'AI агенты' using 'agents' (English) and 'агентов' (Russian).
evals.prompt: search the wiki for agent агенты
evals.expected_behavior: A single default query suffices — each term is stemmed by its own script (`agent*` for the Latin term, `агент*` for the Cyrillic), so the page is found without per-language gymnastics.
must_not: run two separate searches assuming only Russian is stemmed
claim English terms are not stemmed

evals.name: list-membership-tag-filter
evals.setup: Vault `cybos-demo` is registered + indexed with several pages whose frontmatter `tags:` list carries a typed-class tag — e.g. two pages tagged `decision` and one tagged `risk` (TASK 031 typed knowledge classes).
evals.prompt: list every decision page in the cybos-demo vault
evals.expected_behavior: Invokes the list-membership metadata filter — `wiki-search --tag decision --vaults cybos-demo` (or the equivalent `--where 'tags=decision'`), NOT a coarse `--types research` bucket and NOT a bare FTS query for the word 'decision'; returns exactly the two decision-tagged pages (a member match on the tags LIST, TASK 033), excluding the risk page.
must_not: use --where 'tag=decision' (singular; the field is the plural 'tags' list)
fall back to scanning --types research (a coarse bucket that also pulls risk/incident/hypothesis)
claim wiki-search cannot filter by a tags list member
